applicability.rationale: No venue-format requirements or paper-visible formatting details are supplied.
No scope requirements are supplied from which fit can be assessed.
The manuscript reports allocation and analytic choices and therefore requires transparent reporting of material limitations.
The title, abstract, and results make definitive causal claims that can be assessed against the reported design and uncertainty.

evidence_anchor.claim: The manuscript makes definitive causal and eliminative claims despite nonrandom alternating allocation and an interval spanning zero.

remedy.cost_tradeoffs: Narrows the conclusion to what the reported design and uncertainty support.
remedy.minimum_action: Revise the title, abstract, and results to describe a nonrandomized observational comparison and remove definitive causal or eliminative language; report the interval-spanning-zero uncertainty alongside the estimate.

findings.scholarly_relevance: The stated conclusion is stronger than the available design and statistical uncertainty support.

evidence_anchor.claim: The limitations omit allocation bias, analytic flexibility, and imprecision, although allocation alternated by enrollment order and the comparison was selected after outcome distributions were viewed.

remedy.cost_tradeoffs: Makes the study's constraints visible and may reduce the apparent certainty of its conclusions.
remedy.minimum_action: Add a limitations discussion addressing nonrandom allocation, outcome-informed analytic choice, and imprecision, and state how these constraints limit interpretation.

findings.scholarly_relevance: Readers need these design and analytic constraints to judge credibility and interpretability.
